title: Grateful Dead Live at West Palm Beach Civic Center on 1982-09-11

ai_review.summary: A rich Seamons matrix captures a high‑energy 1982 show with standout performances of Scarlet Fire, Terrapin Station, Dupree’s and Stella Blue.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its crisp soundboard foundation blended expertly with audience ambience in the Seamons matrix, delivering a clear and immersive listening experience. The concert itself is described as one of the best of 1982, featuring tight playing and several personal favorites that showcase the band at fire‑level intensity.

ai_rating.rationale: All five reviewers highlight excellent sound quality (crisp matrix, definitive source) and a top‑tier performance (many call it one of the best shows of 1982). The strong consensus and detailed comments support a high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp soundboard core with a well‑balanced audience mix; reviewers note richness, clarity, and that the Seamons matrix adds just the right amount of crowd ambience without distraction.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows through several fan‑favorites with tight transitions, keeping momentum high throughout the concert.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Vocals and guitar are highlighted as excellent; his tone and singing receive specific praise.
band_member_comments.Bob: Vocals praised as awesome alongside Jerry's.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent's keyboards stand out, contributing to the rich sound of the matrix blend.
